title: HB265 (2020 Regular): Handgun Qualification License - Training Requirement - Exemption

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2020RS/bills/hb/hb0265f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed). Never passed a chamber in the text read. The quote joins the two added items (6) and (7) of subsection (e) to the lead-in; the existing exemptions (1)-(5) and the renumbered item (8) are unchanged law.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-117.1(e)): An applicant for a handgun qualification license is not required to complete a firearms safety training course under subsection (d) of this section if the applicant: IS A QUALIFIED RETIRED LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER, AS DEFINED UNDER THE LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS SAFETY ACT, 18 U.S.C. § 926C; IS AN ACTIVE OR RETIRED CORRECTIONAL OFFICER, SHERIFF, OR DEPUTY SHERIFF WHO HAS SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETED AN INITIAL CORRECTIONAL OFFICER, SHERIFF, OR DEPUTY SHERIFF FIREARMS TRAINING COURSE APPROVED BY THE SECRETARY;
